The team is evolving toward a cloud-first, automation-led operating model. While this role is anchored in deep networking expertise, we welcome candidates who bring, or are eager to build, automation and infrastructure-as-code skills. You will help modernise how we operate by replacing manual, repetitive work with codified, repeatable engineering, while acting as a senior technical voice and mentor within the team. Resolve escalated operational issues: Act as a senior escalation point for complex incidents, driving root-cause analysis and permanent resolution. Deliver network projects: Lead new-site builds, refreshes, migrations, and design changes, coordinating with vendors and installation partners through delivery. Support automation and modernisation: Partner with automation and SRE colleagues to automate recurring tasks and move the team from manual operations toward infrastructure as code.
